helpers.audit: async function(label){let result=await alphaTab.playwright.evaluate(()=>{const rgb=s=>(s.match(/[\d.]+/g)||[]).map(Number);const linear=n=>{n/=255;return n<=.04045?n/12.92:((n+.055)/1.055)**2.4};const lum=c=>.2126*linear(c[0])+.7152*linear(c[1])+.0722*linear(c[2]);const problems=[];for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('body *')){if(el.closest('.welcome-art,[aria-hidden="true"],.sr-only,button:disabled')||!el.getBoundingClientRect().width)continue;const text=[...el.childNodes].filter(n=>n.nodeType===3).map(n=>n.textContent).join('').trim();if(!text)continue;const st=getComputedStyle(el);if(st.visibility==='hidden'||Number(st.opacity)<.99)continue;let bg=[248,247,242];for(let p=el;p;p=p.parentElement){const c=rgb(getComputedStyle(p).backgroundColor);if(c.length===3||(c.length===4&&c[3]===1)){bg=c;break;}}const fg=rgb(st.color);if(fg.length<3)continue;const contrast=(Math.max(lum(fg),lum(bg))+.05)/(Math.min(lum(fg),lum(bg))+.05);const size=Number(st.fontSize.replace('px',''));const large=size>=24||(size>=18.66&&Number(st.fontWeight)>=700);if(contrast<(large?3:4.5))problems.push({text:text.slice(0,65),contrast:Math.round(contrast*100)/100,color:st.color,background:bg,font:st.fontSize});}return {width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,h1Count:document.querySelectorAll('h1').length,focused:document.activeElement?.id||document.activeElement?.tagName,contrastProblems:problems,unnamedControls:[...document.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea,button')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0&&!e.getAttribute('aria-label')&&!e.closest('label')&&!e.textContent.trim()).map(e=>e.tagName)};});result.label=label;alphaChecks.push(result);return result;}
